answer.reason: The verses tell of her giving water to Abraham's servant and going to marry Isaac, her conceiving after Isaac's prayer, and her scheme to have Jacob blessed.

clauses.english: gave Abraham's servant and his camels water at the well, and went to become Isaac's wife
clauses.quote: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

clauses.english: conceived twins after Isaac prayed to the LORD, being barren
clauses.quote: Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren

clauses.english: helped Jacob obtain his father's blessing by disguising him as Esau
clauses.quote: Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau

doubts: GEN 24:15-16 and 24:45-46 give her drawing water; the cited run GEN 24:45-46 is used for the well scene.
The blessing deed rests on GEN 27:15-17; the verses are given only in part (the middle of chapter 27 is omitted).
ROM 9:10 spells the name Rebecca; it refers to the same woman and adds nothing beyond GEN 25.
